-- The ref's OWN caps and the ref's OWN names (QuestFrame.lua l.2-3). This used to be a -- private `BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_ITEMS = 6`, halving both — which also forced the detail and -- reward panels to keep TWO pools of 6 (Choice*/Reward*) where the ref packs choices, -- the spell row and fixed rewards into ONE 10-deep pool. The pools are merged below. MAX_NUM_ITEMS = 10 -- detail/reward rows per panel (ref QuestFrame.lua:2) MAX_REQUIRED_ITEMS = 6 -- progress-panel rows (ref QuestFrame.lua:3) BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_TITLES = 10 -- greeting title buttons (active + available combined; ref -- MAX_NUM_QUESTS=32, halved-and-then-some, an existing v1 cap) BENILLA_QUEST_SCROLLCHILD_H = 700 -- the generous scroll-child budget, see header comment
-- The detail write-on (ref QuestFrame.lua:4-6): the reveal edge moves at CPS characters -- per second, fading over LENGTH characters; the objectives/rewards block fades in over -- QUESTINFO_FADE_IN seconds once the text has fully written. QUEST_DESCRIPTION_GRADIENT_LENGTH = 30 QUEST_DESCRIPTION_GRADIENT_CPS = 40 QUESTINFO_FADE_IN = 1
-- "Instant Quest Text" (ref UIOptionsFrame.lua:20 — uvar QUEST_FADING_DISABLE, checkbox -- default "0"). Pinned "1" by direction (2026-07-17): text lands whole, the greeting/ -- progress/reward fade-ins skip — and the quill still scratches ONCE, because that is -- what the ref's instant mode actually does (see the OnShow arm below): it jams the -- reveal edge past the text rather than skipping the write-on, so the first OnUpdate -- tick plays one WriteQuest before the gradient runs off. Instant is one scribble, not -- silence. -- -- The ref home for this uvar is the options window, and that is where it lives now: the -- Interface page's "Instant Quest Text" row drives it (decision 1136), and this assignment -- is the only place the default is written down. Note what that buys — our default is "1" -- where 1.12's table says "0", and because the row CAPTURES its default here rather than -- restating one, the Defaults button walks the page back to the director's pin, not to the -- reference's. Registered for save on the line below, so a player who prefers the fade-in -- keeps it (1128's load order: this assignment, then the saved chunk, then consumers). QUEST_FADING_DISABLE = "1" RegisterForSave("QUEST_FADING_DISABLE")
-- One quest-item row (kind = "choice"/"reward"/"required", 1-based `index`) — unchanged from -- before this pass; every panel's rows share it via `GetQuestItemInfo`. function BenillaQuestItem_Set(button, kind, index) local name, texture, count, quality, usable, itemId = GetQuestItemInfo(kind, index) button.kind = kind button.index = index button:SetID(index) -- ref l.383/487 `questItem:SetID(i)` — the row's 1-based index -- within its KIND, which is what GetID() answers on a real client. button.itemId = itemId -- ref l.388/490 ("-- For the tooltip"): every laid-out reward/choice row is stamped -- rewardType = "item"; the ONE row that ever reads "spell" is the reward-spell row -- (l.445), which v1 doesn't build (GetRewardSpell() is nil, decision 0088). The click -- arms below guard on it exactly as the ref does, so the guard is live the day that -- row lands. (Deviation, harmless: the ref leaves required rows' rewardType unset — -- l.197-200 stamps only `.type` — which reads the same `~= "spell"` either way.) button.rewardType = "item" button.quality = quality button.icon:SetTexture(texture or BENILLA_FALLBACK_ICON) button.name:SetText(name or "...") if (count or 1) > 1 then button.count:SetText(count) else button.count:SetText("") end local r, g, b = 1, 1, 1 if quality and BenillaTooltip_QualityColor then r, g, b = BenillaTooltip_QualityColor(quality) end button.name:SetTextColor(r, g, b) button:Show() end
-- ── The giver MATERIAL (ref QuestFrame.lua l.580-604), verbatim ───────────────────────── -- Every quest panel is drawn on a material: Parchment (the bare corner art) or one of -- Bronze/Marble/Silver/Stone, whose four quadrants overlay it. `SetMaterial` is the ref's -- own body, byte-for-byte in shape; `GetMaterial` is the ref's with its one engine call -- NAMED rather than faked. -- -- **`GetQuestBackgroundMaterial()` IS NOT BOUND** — this engine has no such surface, so -- `QuestFrame_GetMaterial` can only answer the ref's own fallback, "Parchment". That is -- also the ref's answer whenever the getter returns nil, so the code path below is real and -- reached, not a stub: the Parchment arm hides all four quadrants, which is the window we -- ship. Written as a named absence (1134 §4) instead of a nil-returning fake binding — -- a getter that always says nil would read like a working feature on a giver that has one. function QuestFrame_GetMaterial() return "Parchment" end
function QuestFrame_SetMaterial(frame, material) local n = frame:GetName() local corners = { "MaterialTopLeft", "MaterialTopRight", "MaterialBotLeft", "MaterialBotRight" } if material == "Parchment" then for i = 1, 4 do getglobal(n .. corners[i]):Hide() end else for i = 1, 4 do local t = getglobal(n .. corners[i]) t:SetTexture("Interface\\ItemTextFrame\\ItemText-" .. material .. "-" .. string.sub(corners[i], 9)) t:Show() end end end
-- ── The panel scroll kit ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- There isn't one any more: the four panels wear the ref's OWN -- `UIPanelScrollFrameTemplate` (ref l.107/326/508/754), so the wheel, the arrows, the -- draggable Slider thumb and the range/arrow bookkeeping all come from the template's own -- scripts. What stood here was a hand-rolled no-drag bar plus `BenillaQuestScroll_Step`/ -- `_OnMouseWheel`/`_SyncBar`, derived by name off "<scroll>Bar" — a private-name kit that -- published four `Quest<panel>ScrollBar*` families the reference does not have, and that -- pfUI's `skins/blizzard/gossipquest.lua` l.100 fell through: it skins -- `_G[scroll:GetName().."ScrollBar"]`, which only exists on a real template instance. -- -- TWO BEHAVIOUR CHANGES, both toward the reference: the thumb DRAGS now, and the bar STAYS -- (greyed) on a panel with nothing to scroll instead of vanishing — the ref's quest panels -- set no `scrollBarHideable`, so `ScrollFrame_OnScrollRangeChanged` takes its -- disable-and-show arm.
-- Size the ACTIVE panel's scroll child to its measured content — the shared real-scroll -- kit's `BenillaScroll_ResizeChild` (ScrollTemplates.xml), which owns the widget-bottom sum, -- the change-guard, and the UpdateScrollChildRect. The bar needs no nudge from here: the -- resize's own `UpdateScrollChildRect` fires OnScrollRangeChanged, and the template's -- handler seats the arrows and the thumb. function BenillaQuestPanel_Resize(scrollName, widgets) BenillaScroll_ResizeChild(scrollName, widgets) end
-- Per-panel resize candidates: every element that can be the LOWEST visible thing. BENILLA_QUEST_PANEL_WIDGETS = { ["QuestGreetingScrollFrame"] = (function() local t = { "GreetingText", "CurrentQuestsText", "AvailableQuestsText" } for i = 1, BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_TITLES do table.insert(t, "QuestTitleButton" .. i) end return t end)(), ["QuestDetailScrollFrame"] = (function() local t = { "QuestDescription", "QuestObjectiveText", "QuestDetailRewardTitleText", "QuestDetailItemChooseText", "QuestDetailItemReceiveText" } for i = 1, MAX_NUM_ITEMS do table.insert(t, "QuestDetailItem" .. i) end for i = 1, 3 do table.insert(t, "QuestDetailMoneyCoin" .. i) end return t end)(), ["QuestProgressScrollFrame"] = (function() local t = { "QuestProgressText", "QuestProgressRequiredItemsText", "QuestProgressRequiredMoneyText", "QuestProgressMoneyCoin1", "QuestProgressMoneyCoin2", "QuestProgressMoneyCoin3" } for i = 1, MAX_REQUIRED_ITEMS do table.insert(t, "QuestProgressItem" .. i) end return t end)(), ["QuestRewardScrollFrame"] = (function() local t = { "QuestRewardText", "QuestRewardRewardTitleText", "QuestRewardItemChooseText", "QuestRewardItemReceiveText" } for i = 1, MAX_NUM_ITEMS do table.insert(t, "QuestRewardItem" .. i) end for i = 1, 3 do table.insert(t, "QuestRewardMoneyCoin" .. i) end return t end)(), }
BENILLA_QUEST_PANEL_SCROLLS = { greeting = "QuestGreetingScrollFrame", detail = "QuestDetailScrollFrame", progress = "QuestProgressScrollFrame", reward = "QuestRewardScrollFrame", }
-- The convergence driver: while the window shows, keep re-measuring the ACTIVE panel -- (cheap — the resize itself no-ops once the sum stabilizes; the log's own OnUpdate idiom). -- The greeting panel's title rows fit FIRST, so the panel sum below already sees their -- final bottoms in this same pass. function BenillaQuestFrame_OnUpdate() local frame = getglobal("QuestFrame") if not frame:IsVisible() or not frame.panel then return end if frame.panel == "greeting" then for i = 1, BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_TITLES do local button = getglobal("QuestTitleButton" .. i) if button:IsShown() then BenillaQuestTitleButton_Resize(button) end end end local scroll = BENILLA_QUEST_PANEL_SCROLLS[frame.panel] if scroll then BenillaQuestPanel_Resize(scroll, BENILLA_QUEST_PANEL_WIDGETS[scroll]) end end
-- ── Greeting panel (ref QuestFrameGreetingPanel_OnShow, QuestFrame.lua:219-282) ────────────── function QuestTitleButton_OnClick() local button = this if button.isActive then SelectActiveQuest(button.titleIndex) else SelectAvailableQuest(button.titleIndex) end PlaySound("igQuestListSelect") -- ref QuestTitleButton_OnClick, QuestFrame.lua:303 end
-- A title row is as tall as its own wrapped title, +2 (ref QuestFrameGreetingPanel_OnShow's -- `SetHeight(GetTextHeight() + 2)`, QuestFrame.lua:243/272 — the same law GossipFrame.xml's -- `BenillaGossipRow_Resize` runs on the gossip rows). Titles wrap at the ButtonText's 275 px, -- and the rows hang off each other, so a row left at the template's 16px while its title -- draws two lines prints the next title through it. Our GetStringHeight lands a frame after -- the SetText (the measure round-trip), hence the guard + the OnUpdate settle above. function BenillaQuestTitleButton_Resize(button) local text = button:GetFontString() local h = text and text:GetHeight() or 0 if h <= 0 or button.benillaFitHeight == h then return end button.benillaFitHeight = h button:SetHeight(h + 2) end
function BenillaQuestGreetingPanel_OnShow() getglobal("QuestFrameDetailPanel"):Hide() getglobal("QuestFrameProgressPanel"):Hide() getglobal("QuestFrameRewardPanel"):Hide()
local greetingText = getglobal("GreetingText") greetingText:SetText(GetGreetingText() or "") local activeHeader = getglobal("CurrentQuestsText") local availableHeader = getglobal("AvailableQuestsText") local hbreak = getglobal("QuestGreetingFrameHorizontalBreak") local numActive = math.min(GetNumActiveQuests(), BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_TITLES) local numAvailable = math.min(GetNumAvailableQuests(), BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_TITLES - numActive)
-- Current Quests + its title-button run (l.235-253). if numActive == 0 then activeHeader:SetText("") else activeHeader:SetText("Current Quests") activeHeader:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", greetingText, "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -10) for i = 1, numActive do local button = getglobal("QuestTitleButton" .. i) button.isActive = true button.titleIndex = i button:SetText(GetActiveTitle(i)) BenillaQuestTitleButton_Resize(button) button:Show() if i == 1 then button:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", activeHeader, "BOTTOMLEFT", -10, -5) else button:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal("QuestTitleButton" .. (i - 1)), "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, 0) end end end
-- The horizontal break + Available Quests + ITS title-button run (l.254-278) — the break -- shows only when BOTH lists are non-empty (l.256-260). if numActive > 0 and numAvailable > 0 then hbreak:SetTexture("Interface\\QuestFrame\\UI-HorizontalBreak") hbreak:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal("QuestTitleButton" .. numActive), "BOTTOMLEFT", 22, -10) else hbreak:SetTexture(nil) end if numAvailable == 0 then availableHeader:SetText("") else availableHeader:SetText("Available Quests") if numActive > 0 then availableHeader:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", hbreak, "BOTTOMLEFT", -12, -10) else availableHeader:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", greetingText, "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -10) end for i = numActive + 1, numActive + numAvailable do local button = getglobal("QuestTitleButton" .. i) button.isActive = false button.titleIndex = i - numActive button:SetText(GetAvailableTitle(i - numActive)) BenillaQuestTitleButton_Resize(button) button:Show() if i == numActive + 1 then button:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", availableHeader, "BOTTOMLEFT", -10, -5) else button:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal("QuestTitleButton" .. (i - 1)), "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, 0) end end end for i = numActive + numAvailable + 1, BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_TITLES do getglobal("QuestTitleButton" .. i):Hide() end
getglobal("QuestGreetingScrollFrame"):SetVerticalScroll(0) -- The action button inherits `hidden="true"` from `BenillaQuestPanelButtonTemplate` -- (a virtual template — never itself drawn — declared hidden so a bare `inherits=` alone -- doesn't imply "visible"); every panel must :Show() its own buttons explicitly, the same -- way BenillaQuestItem_Set already does for item/title rows. getglobal("QuestFrameGreetingGoodbyeButton"):Show() if QUEST_FADING_DISABLE == "0" then -- ref l.223-226: instant text skips the fade-in UIFrameFadeIn(getglobal("QuestGreetingScrollChildFrame"), QUESTINFO_FADE_IN) end end
function BenillaQuestFrameGreetingGoodbyeButton_OnClick() -- ref l.749-752: no DeclineQuest() call here — the greeting has no in-progress panel to -- decline yet. The window's own OnHide (CloseQuest()) still ends the giver session. HideUIPanel(getglobal("QuestFrame")) end
-- ── The shared reward grid — `QuestFrameItems_Update(questState)`, the REFERENCE'S OWN -- NAME and the reference's own algorithm (QuestFrame.lua:311-522), ported line-for-line. -- -- `questState` is "QuestDetail" or "QuestReward"; both panels read the SAME giver getters -- (`GetNumQuestChoices`/`GetQuestItemInfo`/`GetRewardMoney` are giver-global, not -- panel-specific — `benilla-ui`'s `quest.rs`), exactly as the ref's own one function feeds -- its own two panels. -- -- ONE POOL. This used to be `BenillaQuestItems_Update` over two static 6-deep pools -- (`<panel>Choice1..6` and `<panel>Reward1..6`). The ref packs choices, then the -- reward-spell row, then fixed rewards into a SINGLE `<panel>Item1..10` run with a running -- `rewardsCount`, positioning each at runtime — which is why the ref's rows carry a bare -- TOPLEFT anchor and why the split could not reproduce the function. pfUI is the report -- (`skins/blizzard/gossipquest.lua` l.38-42 walks `QuestProgressItem`/`QuestDetailItem`/ -- `QuestRewardItem` 1..6 and indexes `:GetWidth()` unguarded), and it `hooksecurefunc`es -- this function and `QuestFrameProgressItems_Update` by name. -- -- The SPELL-REWARD arm is transcribed as the ref writes it and is dead on a 1.12 server: -- `GetRewardSpell()` answers nil (decision 0088). Kept rather than dropped because it is -- the arm that advances `rewardsCount` between the choices and the fixed rewards — deleting -- it would silently change every index below it the day the row lands. function QuestFrameItems_Update(questState) local numChoices = GetNumQuestChoices() local numRewards = GetNumQuestRewards() local numSpellRewards = GetRewardSpell() and 1 or 0 local money = GetRewardMoney() local itemName = questState .. "Item" local totalRewards = numChoices + numRewards + numSpellRewards
-- ref l.341-349: the "Rewards" header shows iff there is anything at all to show. local header = getglobal(questState .. "RewardTitleText") header:SetText((totalRewards > 0 or (money and money > 0)) and "Rewards" or "")
-- ref l.358-361: hide the tail of the pool BEFORE laying any of it out. for i = totalRewards + 1, MAX_NUM_ITEMS do getglobal(itemName .. i):Hide() end
local rewardsCount = 0
-- ref l.366-411: choosable rewards, 2-per-row — odd index starts a new row under the -- row two back, even index sits beside the previous. local chooseText = getglobal(questState .. "ItemChooseText") chooseText:SetText(numChoices > 0 and "You may choose one of these rewards:" or "") local lastChoice = math.min(numChoices, MAX_NUM_ITEMS) for i = 1, lastChoice do local index = i + rewardsCount local item = getglobal(itemName .. index) BenillaQuestItem_Set(item, "choice", i) if i == 1 then item:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", chooseText, "BOTTOMLEFT", -3, -5) elseif i % 2 == 1 then item:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal(itemName .. (index - 2)), "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -2) else item:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal(itemName .. (index - 1)), "TOPRIGHT", 1, 0) end end rewardsCount = rewardsCount + lastChoice
-- ref l.414-451: the reward-spell row. Dead here (GetRewardSpell() is nil), and the -- `else` arm is the one that runs — it blanks the label exactly as the ref hides it. local learnSpellText = getglobal(questState .. "SpellLearnText") if learnSpellText then learnSpellText:SetText("") end
-- ref l.454-471: "You will receive:" / "You will also receive:" — shown for a fixed -- reward OR money, even with zero fixed-reward rows (a money-only quest). local receiveText = getglobal(questState .. "ItemReceiveText") if numRewards > 0 or (money and money > 0) then if numChoices > 0 then receiveText:SetText("You will also receive:") local index = lastChoice if index % 2 == 0 then index = index - 1 end receiveText:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal(itemName .. index), "BOTTOMLEFT", 3, -5) else receiveText:SetText("You will receive:") receiveText:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", header, "BOTTOMLEFT", 3, -5) end else receiveText:SetText("") end
-- ref l.474-513: fixed rewards, the SAME 2-per-row walk, continuing the pool. local lastReward = math.min(numRewards, MAX_NUM_ITEMS - rewardsCount) for i = 1, lastReward do local index = i + rewardsCount local item = getglobal(itemName .. index) BenillaQuestItem_Set(item, "reward", i) if i == 1 then item:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", receiveText, "BOTTOMLEFT", -3, -5) elseif i % 2 == 1 then item:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal(itemName .. (index - 2)), "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -2) else item:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal(itemName .. (index - 1)), "TOPRIGHT", 1, 0) end end
if money and money > 0 then BenillaMoney_Set(questState .. "Money", money, true) else BenillaMoney_Clear(questState .. "Money") end end
-- ── Detail panel (ref QuestFrameDetailPanel_OnShow, QuestFrame.lua:524-552) ────────────────── function BenillaQuestDetailPanel_OnShow() getglobal("QuestFrameGreetingPanel"):Hide() getglobal("QuestFrameProgressPanel"):Hide() getglobal("QuestFrameRewardPanel"):Hide()
getglobal("QuestTitleText"):SetText(GetTitleText() or "") getglobal("QuestDescription"):SetText(GetQuestText() or "") getglobal("QuestDetailObjectiveTitleText"):SetText("Quest Objectives") getglobal("QuestObjectiveText"):SetText(GetObjectiveText() or "") QuestFrameItems_Update("QuestDetail") getglobal("QuestDetailScrollFrame"):SetVerticalScroll(0) getglobal("QuestFrameAcceptButton"):Show() getglobal("QuestFrameDeclineButton"):Show()
-- Arm the write-on (ref l.538-551): objectives/rewards invisible and Accept dead -- until the description has finished writing itself onto the parchment. getglobal("QuestDetailTextAlphaFrame"):SetAlpha(0) getglobal("QuestFrameAcceptButton"):Disable() local panel = getglobal("QuestFrameDetailPanel") panel.fading = 1 panel.fadingProgress = 0 getglobal("QuestDescription"):SetAlphaGradient(0, QUEST_DESCRIPTION_GRADIENT_LENGTH) -- Instant text (ref l.549-551): the write-on still arms, but the reveal edge starts -- past any quest text's end — the first OnUpdate tick scratches the quill once, runs -- the gradient off, and wakes everything on the spot. if QUEST_FADING_DISABLE == "1" then panel.fadingProgress = 1024 end end
-- ref QuestFrameDetailPanel_OnUpdate (QuestFrame.lua:555-570): advance the reveal edge, -- scratching the WriteQuest quill each tick — the kit's no-duplicates flag (0x20) keeps -- the per-frame PlaySound from stacking (a new scribble only starts when the previous -- wav ends, which IS the continuous writing sound). When the gradient runs off the end -- of the text, fade the objectives/rewards block in (or snap it on, instant mode) and -- wake the Accept button. With instant text the arm above started the edge at 1024, so -- all of this happens on the first tick: one scratch, then the wake. function BenillaQuestDetailPanel_OnUpdate(panel, elapsed) if panel.fading then panel.fadingProgress = panel.fadingProgress + (elapsed * QUEST_DESCRIPTION_GRADIENT_CPS) PlaySound("WriteQuest") if not getglobal("QuestDescription"):SetAlphaGradient(panel.fadingProgress, QUEST_DESCRIPTION_GRADIENT_LENGTH) then panel.fading = nil if QUEST_FADING_DISABLE == "0" then UIFrameFadeIn(getglobal("QuestDetailTextAlphaFrame"), QUESTINFO_FADE_IN) else -- instant: the block snaps on, no fade (ref l.561-564) getglobal("QuestDetailTextAlphaFrame"):SetAlpha(1) end getglobal("QuestFrameAcceptButton"):Enable() end end end
function QuestFrameAcceptButton_OnClick() AcceptQuest() end
function QuestFrameDeclineButton_OnClick() -- DeclineQuest() DOES send (decision 1738, byte-verified — this comment used to claim -- the opposite for years): the app's session-end routine re-opens the giver's list -- (CMSG_QUESTGIVER_HELLO / CMSG_GOSSIP_HELLO), which is what puts you back in an NPC's -- menu after a decline, or answers a party member's share. Either way the panel is -- hidden here immediately rather than waiting on a packet — the same convention every -- NPC window's close button already uses (e.g. BenillaMerchantCloseButton_OnClick). DeclineQuest() PlaySound("igQuestCancel") -- ref QuestFrameDeclineButton_OnClick, QuestFrame.lua:577 HideUIPanel(getglobal("QuestFrame")) end
-- ── Progress panel (ref QuestFrameProgressPanel_OnShow/Items_Update, QuestFrame.lua:143-217) -- ITS OWN grid — NOT the choose/reward one above: item1 is the only Lua-repositioned row (below -- the required-money line when money is required, else below the header directly, l.186-192); -- items 2-6 are a STATIC XML 2-column×3-row chain off item1/item3/item5 (ref l.416-460) that -- the resolver's fixpoint keeps correctly re-propagated as item1 moves — no Lua needed for -- them at all. ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- The progress panel's own grid, under the REFERENCE'S OWN NAME (ref -- `QuestFrameProgressItems_Update`, QuestFrame.lua:165-217) — pfUI `hooksecurefunc`es it by -- that name (`skins/blizzard/gossipquest.lua` l.131), which is why it is a function rather -- than a block inside the OnShow it used to live in. -- -- NOT the choose/reward walk above: `QuestProgressItem1` is the only Lua-repositioned row -- (below the required-money line when money is required, else below the header directly, -- ref l.186-192); items 2-6 are a STATIC XML 2-column x 3-row chain off items 1/3/5 (ref -- l.416-460) that the resolver's fixpoint keeps re-propagated as item1 moves. function QuestFrameProgressItems_Update() local numItems = math.min(GetNumQuestItems(), MAX_REQUIRED_ITEMS) local money = GetQuestMoneyToGet() local reqText = getglobal("QuestProgressRequiredItemsText") local moneyText = getglobal("QuestProgressRequiredMoneyText") local item1 = getglobal("QuestProgressItem1") if numItems > 0 or (money and money > 0) then reqText:SetText("Items Needed:") if money and money > 0 then moneyText:SetText("Required Money:") BenillaMoney_Set("QuestProgressMoney", money, true) item1:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", moneyText, "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -10) else moneyText:SetText("") BenillaMoney_Clear("QuestProgressMoney") item1:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", reqText, "BOTTOMLEFT", -3, -5) end else reqText:SetText("") moneyText:SetText("") BenillaMoney_Clear("QuestProgressMoney") end for i = 1, MAX_REQUIRED_ITEMS do if i <= numItems then BenillaQuestItem_Set(getglobal("QuestProgressItem" .. i), "required", i) else getglobal("QuestProgressItem" .. i):Hide() end end end
function BenillaQuestProgressPanel_OnShow() getglobal("QuestFrameGreetingPanel"):Hide() getglobal("QuestFrameDetailPanel"):Hide() getglobal("QuestFrameRewardPanel"):Hide()
getglobal("QuestProgressTitleText"):SetText(GetTitleText() or "") getglobal("QuestProgressText"):SetText(GetProgressText() or "")
QuestFrameProgressItems_Update()
local continueButton = getglobal("QuestFrameCompleteButton") if IsQuestCompletable() then continueButton:Enable() else continueButton:Disable() end continueButton:Show() getglobal("QuestFrameGoodbyeButton"):Show() getglobal("QuestProgressScrollFrame"):SetVerticalScroll(0) if QUEST_FADING_DISABLE == "0" then -- ref l.159-162: instant text skips the fade-in UIFrameFadeIn(getglobal("QuestProgressScrollChildFrame"), QUESTINFO_FADE_IN) end end
function BenillaQuestFrameCompleteButton_OnClick() CompleteQuest() -- the progress panel's "Continue" — requests the reward offer end
function BenillaQuestFrameGoodbyeButton_OnClick() DeclineQuest() PlaySound("igQuestCancel") -- ref QuestGoodbyeButton_OnClick, QuestFrame.lua:112 HideUIPanel(getglobal("QuestFrame")) end
-- ── Reward panel (ref QuestFrameRewardPanel_OnShow + reward-item clicks, QuestFrame.lua:72-141) function BenillaQuestRewardPanel_OnShow() getglobal("QuestFrameGreetingPanel"):Hide() getglobal("QuestFrameDetailPanel"):Hide() getglobal("QuestFrameProgressPanel"):Hide()
getglobal("QuestRewardTitleText"):SetText(GetTitleText() or "") getglobal("QuestRewardText"):SetText(GetRewardText() or "") getglobal("QuestFrame").itemChoice = 0 getglobal("QuestRewardItemHighlight"):Hide() QuestFrameItems_Update("QuestReward") getglobal("QuestRewardScrollFrame"):SetVerticalScroll(0) getglobal("QuestFrameCompleteQuestButton"):Show() getglobal("QuestFrameCancelButton"):Show() -- ref l.85-88: the whole parchment content fades in — unless the text is instant. if QUEST_FADING_DISABLE == "0" then getglobal("QuestRewardScrollChildFrame"):SetAlpha(0) UIFrameFadeIn(getglobal("QuestRewardScrollChildFrame"), QUESTINFO_FADE_IN) end end
-- ── The item-row modifier fork, shared by every quest-item row in this window ───────────── -- ref QuestItem_OnClick (QuestFrame.lua:115-125), the OnClick QuestItemTemplate itself -- carries (QuestFrameTemplates.xml:162-164) — so it covers the DETAIL panel's choice/reward -- rows, the PROGRESS panel's required rows, and the reward panel's FIXED reward rows. -- CTRL previews the item in the dressing room (decision 1060), SHIFT posts its link into an -- open chat edit box (decision 1059); a plain click does nothing here, which is why these -- rows carried no OnClick before this arc. -- -- Two guards the ref's own code has, transcribed: the ctrl arm is gated on -- `this.rewardType ~= "spell"` (l.117 — a spell reward has no item to wear), and the shift -- arm additionally requires the edit box to be VISIBLE (l.121; the `and rewardType ~= -- "spell"` rides the same line there). Ours adds `ChatFrameEditBox and` — ChatFrame.xml is -- a separate file a window test need not load, exactly as BenillaPaperDollSlot_OnClick does. -- -- One benilla-only guard: `link` is nil until the ask-once item template lands (a state the -- reference's synchronous item cache never has), and EditBox:Insert takes a string. The ref -- already carries the twin of this guard inside DressUpItemLink (ref DressUpFrame.lua:11-13). function QuestItem_OnClick() local button = this if IsControlKeyDown() then if button.rewardType ~= "spell" then DressUpItemLink(GetQuestItemLink(button.kind, button.index)) end elseif IsShiftKeyDown() then -- The ref's spell guard rides this arm (l.121); the "edit box up" and "link not -- nil" pair is the shared helper's (UIParent.xml — one law, one place). if button.rewardType ~= "spell" then BenillaChatEdit_InsertLink(GetQuestItemLink(button.kind, button.index)) end end end
-- ref QuestRewardItem_OnClick (l.127-141), the OnClick the REWARD panel's choice rows carry -- through QuestRewardItemTemplate (QuestFrameTemplates.xml:169-171). The first two arms are -- QuestItem_OnClick's verbatim (only the shift arm's spell guard differs — the ref drops it -- here, l.133); the choice SELECT is the THIRD arm, so a ctrl- or shift-click must NOT also -- pick the reward. That ordering is the whole point of the fork. function QuestRewardItem_OnClick() local button = this if IsControlKeyDown() then if button.rewardType ~= "spell" then DressUpItemLink(GetQuestItemLink(button.kind, button.index)) end elseif IsShiftKeyDown() then -- No spell guard on this arm — the ref drops it here (l.133). The visible/non-nil -- pair is the shared helper's (UIParent.xml). function QuestFrame_OnEvent(event) local frame = this if event == "QUEST_FINISHED" then HideUIPanel(frame) frame.panel = nil return end if event == "QUEST_ITEM_UPDATE" then -- The in-place refresh also carries the NPC name (arg1) — in live play the ask-once -- name often lands one frame AFTER the panel opened, arriving exactly here; dropping -- it left the title bar blank (caught reviewing the ui-quest capture). if arg1 and arg1 ~= "" then getglobal("QuestFrameNpcNameText"):SetText(arg1) end if frame:IsVisible() and frame.panel then BenillaQuestFrame_Repaint(frame.panel) end return end
getglobal("QuestFrameNpcNameText"):SetText(arg1 or "") if event == "QUEST_GREETING" then frame.panel = "greeting" elseif event == "QUEST_DETAIL" then frame.panel = "detail" elseif event == "QUEST_PROGRESS" then frame.panel = "progress" elseif event == "QUEST_COMPLETE" then frame.panel = "reward" end
